prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, high-contrast low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette, textured brushwork and physically tactile surfaces, legible silhouette at 200 pixels. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, floating runes, or unsupported anatomy.
ANATOMY: MERETSEGER, living single COBRA-form protector of Valley of Kings. One natural cobra head, broad hood, two natural eyes, one continuous legless body coiling diagonally across large rock-cut tomb steps; NO human features/body, crown, solar disk, extra heads, limbs or fantasy jewelry. [meretseger-c01/c06] MOMENT: Swing the reared hood into a side-forward confrontation across the stairway, head lowered toward viewer and mouth open in warning hiss, main fangs visible; body coil braces dynamically around the foreground step, tail emerges at far lower edge. POWER: venomous bite threatens documented punishment of transgression, natural fang moisture only, no unsupported magical emissions. [meretseger-c05] SCALE & CAMERA: low three-quarter view hugging the stone stair, huge near cobra head at upper-left and sweeping coiled body across lower-right, entire animal fills square, tomb opening narrow behind; close-perspective dominance not literal giant size. LIGHT & WEATHER: one moon shaft from desert doorway, dark walnut shadows and antique-gold edge on scales, dust kicked from stone by coil. SURFACE: irregular dry scale texture, rough sandstone, natural mouth/fangs. SETTING: small rock temple/tomb entrance in protected Theban necropolis, no readable inscriptions. [meretseger-c01/c04] MOOD: active imposing guardian, unmistakable living creature not bronze statue, not a peaceful snake in scenic desert.

visual_requirements.description: Living single cobra-form protector, one head and one continuous legless serpentine body, expanded hood and normal natural cobra fangs; no human body, crown or fantasy extra heads.
Active warning/lunge with visible poisonous fangs and non-glowing liquid venom bead, source poisonous bite; no unsupported poison cloud or magical aura.
Protects Theban necropolis/Valley of Kings, rock-cut tomb/temple entrance and workers' worn stone appropriate peripheral setting.

selection_reason: Retained stairway three-quarter guardian alternative: whole body sweep stronger but head/fangs smaller than A.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: one living cobra head/expanded hood in side-forward warning confrontation on tomb stairs, open mouth shows two major fangs, continuous legless coiled body sweeps into near foreground, no separate second head. Low perspective and disturbed dust, moon through doorway, no crown, woman body, fantasy appendage, poison cloud, text or gore.
limitations: Body tail end beyond lower foreground frame; continuity visible through coiled body.
Species, scale pattern, fang length and tomb layout editorial.
Warm secondary reflected tones chosen pictorially around one moon source.
